g.text: +redeemInvitation(tokenHash: bytes, intendedUserId: UserId, credential: ActivationCredential, now: DateTime): void
-assertRedeemable(tokenHash: bytes, intendedUserId: UserId, method: ActivationMethod, now: DateTime): void
Runs the callback within one transaction.
The callback locks, redeems and persists
redeemInvitation is the AA07 entry point.
It validates all preconditions before mutation
and applies the complete first activation.
LOCAL carries an optional first password.
EXTERNAL carries both identity and verified email.
